blocks.text: @deepseek_ai 已发布 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017，这是对其旗舰模型 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的更新。在第一方 API 上，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 的高峰时段定价为每 100 万输入 token 0.30 美元、每 100 万输出 token 1.20 美元，非高峰时段定价为高峰费率的一半，与 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的定价相同。

inlines.text: @deepseek_ai 已发布 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017，这是对其旗舰模型 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的更新。在第一方 API 上，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 的高峰时段定价为每 100 万输入 token 0.30 美元、每 100 万输出 token 1.20 美元，非高峰时段定价为高峰费率的一半，与 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的定价相同。

blocks.text:
关键结果：
➤ DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 在智能体能力、知识和科学推理方面取得提升。DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 在 GDPval-AA v2.1 上的 Elo 评分为 1746，比 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的 1600 分提高了 146 分。在 AA-Briefcase v1.1 上，其 Elo 评分从 1420 提高到 1570，提升了 150 分。在 AA-Omniscience 上，其非幻觉率为 33%，比 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的 4% 提升了 29 个百分点，同时准确率从 43% 提升到 46%，使其 AA-Omniscience Index 总分从 -5 提升到 +5。在 CritPt 上，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 得分为 24%，高于 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的 14%。

blocks.text: @deepseek_ai has released DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, an update on their flagship model DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. On the first-party API, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is priced at $0.30 per 1M input tokens and $1.20 per 1M output tokens during peak hours, with off-peak pricing half of peak rates, the same pricing as DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

inlines.text: @deepseek_ai has released DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, an update on their flagship model DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. On the first-party API, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is priced at $0.30 per 1M input tokens and $1.20 per 1M output tokens during peak hours, with off-peak pricing half of peak rates, the same pricing as DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

blocks.text:
Key results:
➤ DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 makes gains in agentic capabilities, knowledge and scientific reasoning. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017’s Elo rating on GDPval-AA v2.1 is 1746, an increase of 146 points from DeepSeek V4.1 Flash’s rating of 1600. On AA-Briefcase v1.1, its Elo rating increases by 150 points from 1420 to 1570. On AA-Omniscience, its non-hallucination rate is 33%, a 29-point improvement from DeepSeek V4.1 Flash’s 4%, while seeing an improvement in accuracy from 43% to 46%, pushing its overall AA-Omniscience Index score from -5 to +5. On CritPt, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 scores 24%, up from 14% for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
